findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Fintype/Defs.lean:204 `instance decidablePiFintype {α} {β : α → Type*} [∀ a, DecidableEq (β a)] [Fintype α] : DecidableEq (∀ a, β a)`; grep for `signCount_eq_count` in code/TauCeti hits only its own declaration at Polynomial.lean:61.
findings.fix: Define `signCount Z Q σ := count (fun x : Z => fun j => sign ((Q j).eval x.val)) σ` as a plain term with no `classical`; make `signCount_eq_count` the `@[simp]` unfolding lemma (`:= rfl`) and use it in `restricted_moments`, `fullInverse_signSum`, and `recovered_pos` instead of unfolding by defeq/`simp only [signCount]`.
findings.issue: `signCount` is a tactic-block definition using `classical` although `DecidableEq (J → SignType)` is already available from `Fintype.decidablePiFintype` (needs only `[Fintype J]` and `DecidableEq SignType`). `signCount_eq_count` (`classical; rfl`, line 65) and `exact count_moments _ ...` in `restricted_moments` (line 86) succeed only because the low-priority classical instance is never chosen, an accident not documented anywhere. `signCount_eq_count` is also unused: `fullInverse_signSum` and `recovered_pos` unfold `signCount` with `simp only [signCount]` instead.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Mul.lean:713 `def mulVec [Fintype n] (M : Matrix m n α) (v : n → α) : m → α | i => (fun j => M i j) ⬝ᵥ v`; :75 `def dotProduct ... := ∑ i, v i * w i`. The goal at Polynomial.lean:100-101 mentions neither `*ᵥ` nor `Matrix.of`, so `exact` succeeds only through these unfoldings.
findings.fix: Replace with `have h := congrFun (restricted_moments Z Q id (fun (_ : Unit) => e) Function.injective_id (fun x => ⟨_, rfl⟩)) ()` followed by `simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, id] using h.symm` (or derive it directly from `count_moments` and rewrite with `Matrix.mulVec`/`dotProduct`).
findings.issue: `signSum_prod_pow` is closed by `exact (congrFun (restricted_moments ...) ()).symm`, whose type is `(Matrix.of ... *ᵥ ...) () = ...`, against a goal written as `∑ σ, (∏ j, ...) * (signCount ...)`. The match relies on definitional unfolding of `Matrix.mulVec`, `dotProduct`, and the `Matrix.of` equivalence coercion, with no comment; the rubric asks for an explicit rewrite here.

findings.evidence: Moments.lean:183-189: `have hm := count_moments obs id ...; simp only [id_eq] at hm; rw [← hm, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]; have hi := full_left_inverse J; simp only [fullMatrix] at hi; rw [hi, Matrix.one_mulVec]`. The `simp only [fullMatrix] at hi` step exists solely to make the `rw` match the `Matrix.of` form.
findings.fix: Add a lemma `fullMatrix_mulVec_count (obs : X → (J → SignType)) : fullMatrix J *ᵥ (fun σ => (count obs σ : ℚ)) = fun e => ∑ x, ∏ j, (obs x j : ℚ) ^ (e j).val := count_moments obs id Function.injective_id (fun x => ⟨obs x, rfl⟩) _` (or prove it via `ext e; simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, count_moments]`), then prove `fullInverse_mulVec` by `rw [← fullMatrix_mulVec_count, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, full_left_inverse, Matrix.one_mulVec]`.
findings.issue: `fullInverse_mulVec` takes `full_left_inverse J`, unfolds `fullMatrix` inside the hypothesis with `simp only [fullMatrix] at hi`, and then `rw [hi]` against the `Matrix.of` term produced by `count_moments`. This works only if the unfolded body of `fullMatrix` syntactically coincides with the beta-reduced `count_moments` instance; the matrix identity should be applied to the named `fullMatrix J`, not to its definitional body.

summary: The two `change` steps from the prior round are gone and the Moments.lean proofs are now robust and readable. Remaining issues: `signCount` is defined by an unnecessary `by classical; exact`, so its `rfl` lemma and the `exact count_moments` in `restricted_moments` only work because the classical instance is never selected; `signSum_prod_pow` closes an explicit-sum goal by definitional unfolding of `Matrix.mulVec`/`dotProduct`/`Matrix.of`; and `fullInverse_mulVec` unfolds `fullMatrix` inside a hypothesis to make `rw` match instead of using a named lemma.
